description: 9hentai.to gallery page (/g/<id>/), an nhentai-clone built as a Vue 2 SPA (Vue CLI bundles, bootstrap-vue navbar, scoped data-v-* attributes on every element, <!----> v-if placeholders, vue-lazyload lazy="loaded"/"loading" attributes with a /img/loading.gif src on images not yet in view), captured as the DOM after JS ran. Metadata is present TWICE: (1) vue-meta tags in the head: og:image = the cover, and three JSON-LD blocks - a WebSite with SearchAction, a BreadcrumbList (Home > Doujinshi > Quill Siwx > title), and a schema.org Book with name (full bracketed title), alternateName (Japanese), image (= cover) and thumbnailUrl (page 1 preview, NOT the cover), numberOfPages 26, inLanguage, datePublished '2024-02-10T15:41:07+00:00' and dateModified (later), author = [Person 'Quill Vjtw', Organization 'Quill Ejwu' (the circle, not an artist)], translator Organization 'PenOvba' (scanlator, not a group), character Persons, about = the parody, genre = exactly the tags, keywords = a comma string mixing tags with parody/characters/artist/circle/language/category and SEO words, publisher Organization '9Hentai' (the site, not a group), aggregateRating and interactionStatistic; (2) the nhentai-like info block div#info: h1.title (full bracketed title), h2.alt-title, section#tags of div.tag-container rows labelled with SINGULAR names and a colon in span.tag-type ('Parody:', 'Character:', 'Tag:', 'Artist:', 'Group:', 'Language:', 'Category:'), each entity a.tag > span.name + span.count ('112,503'). Every entity link is the same opaque /t/<numeric id>/ shape, so the kind comes only from the row label (or the JSON-LD role), never from the URL. The DOM shows the page count as '26 pages' and the date only as RELATIVE 'Uploaded 8 months ago' - the concrete day comes from JSON-LD datePublished. Noise: navbar index links and a Language dropdown, search, exoclick ad iframes, 12 preview thumbnails (6 loaded, 6 placeholder), 'Show all (26)', a 'More Like This' grid of six cards with their own cover.jpg images (three loaded) on the same CDN path shape, bracketed titles by other circles/artists (one by the SAME circle about PenOche), and per-card tag links using the same a.tag /t/<id>/ markup; a Disqus iframe; footer 'Popular tags:' links. Unsure of: whether 9hentai emits JSON-LD at all (this is the most plausible shape for a vue-meta SPA), the real labels (singular vs plural), class names, the CDN host (cdn.9hentai.to/images/<id>/cover.jpg, preview/<n>t.jpg), and whether tag links are /t/<id>/ or carry a type. All names and ids are invented.
